scope: Original source timing retained over declared used ranges; root displacement is deliberate. Foot support is measured only in trusted core intervals. No sensor ground truth, physical balance or visual acceptance is claimed.

results.scope: Actual GLB skinned sole corners and complete original skin, not solver-provided points. Full skin 120Hz plus support-boundary windows120Hz; soles and limb lengths120Hz. These sampled checks are not continuous collision or physical-balance proof. Jitter/support comparisons exclude authored transitions and holds; jitter is sampled at the original30Hz source times.

near_ground_motion_proxy.definition: Flat sole tilt<10deg, lowest corner between -2mm and35mm; horizontal center speed diagnostic, not independently labelled contact truth

unanchored_reach_projections.scope: Unanchored IK reach projections have requested and actual support weight zero; these are free-foot trajectory corrections, not broken planted contacts.

support_coverage.scope: Action support is separate from authored default holds. No requested action support means N/A, not proof of anchoring.
